text: 北京市第二中级人民法院10日依法公开宣判原中国银行保险监督管理委员会城市商业银行监管部一级巡视员李世谦受贿一案，对李世谦以受贿罪判处有期徒刑十一年，并处罚金人民币一百万元。追缴被告人李世谦受贿违法所得，予以没收，上缴国库。（新华社）
text_en: The Beijing No. 2 Intermediate People's Court on the 10th publicly sentenced Li Shiqian, former first-level inspector of the City Commercial Bank Supervision Department of the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, in a bribery case, handing down an 11-year prison sentence for accepting bribes and a fine of 1 million yuan. The illegal gains from Li Shiqian's bribery were recovered and confiscated and turned over to the state treasury. (Xinhua)
